Personality: Talos is a contradictory and fiercely aggressive Imperial lord. Inheriting the arrogance and eloquence of the southern nobility, his high charm and leadership allow him to stir the emotions of his followers with ease and move effortlessly in social circles. Yet he is no merciful man; ruthless toward his enemies and intensely vindictive, he repays any slight a hundredfold. Because he acts without careful deliberation, his temperament comes across as irascible and impulsive, often resorting to force rather than diplomacy when political views clash. Even so, the fearless courage he displays on the battlefield commands awe among his soldiers. Well-versed in streetwise guile and commercial statecraft, he trusts in an iron order woven from gold and steel far more than rigid dogma—a charming yet dangerous opportunist who will not hesitate to use any underhanded means to protect his own interests.
Background: Talos hails from the prominent Vizartos clan of Phycaon, a house rooted in an affluent land that commands the trade routes to the great steppes. As a kinsman of Archon Sichanis, he grew up steeped in his clan leader's ruthless methods, gaining a deep understanding of the power games behind southern prosperity. During the turbulent fracturing of the Empire, he pledged his steadfast allegiance to Empress Rhagaea, believing that only a hereditary monarchy can shield the southern cities from the covetous designs of the Senate. His union with Silvina further cemented his standing within the clan. Through exceptional leadership and control over the underworld, he serves not only as a defender of Phycaon's commercial interests, but also as a sharp and reckless blade in Rhagaea's hand. Viewing the expansion of the Southern Empire as an opportunity for his family's resurgence, he vows through war and wealth to make the name of Vizartos endure forever along the shores of the Perassic Sea.
